summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K disclosing that the EMA's Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use adopted a positive opinion recommending EU marketing authorization for once-weekly TransCon CNP (navepegritide) in pediatric achondroplasia, ages two and older with open epiphyses. The submission rested on three randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials plus up to three years of open-label extension data; the product carried orphan designation, and EMA will reassess whether that status holds. A final European Commission decision is expected in Q4 2026, with first EU launch as YUVIWEL targeted for Germany in Q1 2027. This is a routine regulatory milestone, not a special situation; watch EC timing, orphan-status retention, and launch economics.
